sam: approving after that. @lina can you add the release hold? we need to gate docs merges with the feature-flag cutoff on 2026-03-22 18:00 PT.

lina: thanks everyone. once the migration note is in and approvals are set, ops please merge in-window. if anything else shows up, drop it here.
